criteria.requirement: No duplicate unsafe side effects across executor, retry and restart flows
criteria.reason: Only the existing in-process RetentionPurger is exercised. Workflow execution and idempotent retry dependencies BLU-016 and BLU-019, plus restart recovery, are not implemented or validated in this PR.

criteria.requirement: Failed or protected RetentionPurger stores are not cleared, and retried failed entries do not repeat successful clears

tests.name: a persistent fault keeps failing without side effects or a stuck lock
a faulting protected store is refused and never even attempted

criteria.requirement: Scripted faults have reproducible typed outcomes and failures remain explicit

tests.name: every store failing differently is reported per store
a persistent fault keeps failing without side effects or a stuck lock

criteria.requirement: Hung operations finish within a bounded timeout and allow subsequent purges
criteria.reason: The existing purger has no per-store timeout. The regression test documents that a simulated hang keeps it busy; the production timeout/cancellation policy is outside this test-only PR.

criteria.requirement: No secrets, personal data, raw screenshots or unauthorized egress across the full app and CI artifacts
criteria.reason: Tests use fabricated paths and offline in-memory stores. They do not certify end-to-end log/artifact redaction, screenshots, or system-wide network isolation.

criteria.requirement: Pure RetentionPurger failure results expose exception types only and no underlying file paths

tests.name: failed outcomes never reveal fake secret paths

criteria.requirement: Cross-platform compatibility and limitations of in-process simulation reviewed
criteria.reason: No production code or OS permissions are changed. Process crash/restart, real disk-full, real permission revocation and physical-device behavior still require platform-specific validation and maintainer review.
